synopsis: In the early 21st century, the majority of Earth’s landmass is submerged due to rising sea levels. Enter the Fleet of Fog, a host of sentient alien battleships of unknown origin who easily decimate earth’s naval forces. Humanity is now on the verge of extinction. synopsis: One day, Charlotte Bennett joins Akito Aoyagi's class as a student studying abroad. Everyone in the class is attracted to Charlotte's beautiful appearance and elegant demeanor, but Akito feels like "we belong in different worlds" and stays away. However, Akito's daily life drastically changes when he rescues Charlotte's younger sister, Emma, when she got lost. He finds out that the Bennett sisters live in the apartment next door to his, and since Emma had taken to Akito, the Bennett sisters start coming over to Akito's place every day. The three of them play dominoes, sit around the dinner table, and go out together. As they spend time together, Akito and Charlotte grow closer, in their own clumsy way… (Source: NicoNico Seiga, translated)
